sentences.text: Baylor University -LRB- BU -RRB- is a private Baptist university in Waco , Texas .	Baptist	Baptist	Waco	Waco, Texas	Texas	Texas

Chartered in 1845 by the last Congress of the Republic of Texas , it is the oldest continuously-operating university in Texas and one of the first educational institutions west of the Mississippi River in the United States .	Texas	Texas	Mississippi River	Mississippi River

Located on the banks of the Brazos River next to I-35 , between the Dallas-Fort Worth Metroplex and Austin , the university 's 1,000-acre campus is the largest Baptist university campus in the world .	Baptist	Baptist	Brazos	Brazos	I-35	I-35	Dallas-Fort Worth Metroplex	Dallas-Fort Worth Metroplex	Austin	Austin

Baylor University is accredited by the Southern Association of Colleges and Schools but is currently on `` warning '' due to suspected non-compliance with SACS requirements , it is the least severe non-compliant status a university can be placed on .	SACS	Southern Association of Colleges and Schools	Southern Association of Colleges and Schools	Southern Association of Colleges and Schools
Baylor University 's athletic teams , known as the Bears , participate in 19 intercollegiate sports .	Bears	Baylor Bears

The university is a member of the Big 12 Conference in the NCAA Division I.	NCAA Division I	NCAA Division I	Big 12	Big 12 Conference	Big 12 Conference	Big 12 Conference	NCAA	NCAA	Division I	Division I (NCAA)
